Re-verified empirically on 2026-08-07 against ai@7.0.58 + @openrouter/ai-sdk-provider@3.0.0 (spec v4): a full generateText() round-trip against a stubbed OpenRouter endpoint completed (POST /api/v1/chat/completions, finishReason 'stop').

@openrouter/ai-sdk-provider@3.0.0 is npm `latest` (2026-08-07) and RETIRES the 6.0.0-alpha.1 alpha-line residual. It declares peerDependencies ai@^7.0.0 + zod@^3.25.76||^4.1.8 and has NO runtime dependencies; it installs cleanly next to ai@7.0.58 with no ERESOLVE (verified empirically). It emits specificationVersion 'v4' (the alpha emitted 'v3') and preserves the createOpenRouter({ apiKey }) -> openrouter('provider/slug') call style the compiler templates emit; the baseURL option is still accepted (OPENROUTER_BASE_URL redirect path).

BEHAVIOR CHANGE in @openrouter/ai-sdk-provider@3.0.0 -- key loading is now LAZY. Verified empirically on 2026-08-07: with no apiKey and no OPENROUTER_API_KEY, `createOpenRouter({})('provider/slug')` CONSTRUCTS SUCCESSFULLY and returns a spec-v4 model; AI_LoadAPIKeyError ('OpenRouter API key is missing...') is thrown only at the first model CALL (doGenerate/doStream). The old 6.0.0-alpha.1 pin threw at construction (re-verified as the baseline in the same session). This is strictly more permissive, so the generated agent.ts guard -- construct the OpenRouter model only when OPENROUTER_API_KEY is set, otherwise emit the model-id STRING -- keeps working and keyless `eve build` stays alive. But the guard's DOC COMMENTS in packages/compiler/src/codegen/agent.ts (and anywhere else asserting a construction-time throw) are now factually wrong and must be corrected. Do not weaken the guard: without it a keyless build would silently produce a model object whose first turn fails at call time instead of falling back to gateway routing.

eve 0.31.0 replaced the continuation-token session API with fixed, ID-addressed session handles. Route surface as of 0.31.3: POST /eve/v1/session (create + first message, 202 {ok,sessionId,status:'accepted'}), POST /eve/v1/session/:sessionId (follow-up; `message` XOR `inputResponses`), and the control routes /cancel, /clear, /compact, /reset, plus GET /eve/v1/session/:sessionId/stream. Every one of those routes returns 400 if the request body merely CONTAINS a `continuationToken` key; an unknown or terminal session id answers 409 with code 'session_not_active'. The NDJSON stream is version 21 and stamps an evt_-prefixed ULID at meta.id. This matrix bump is therefore a protocol migration, not a patch: see the design spec and docs/runtime-worker-contract.md.

Custom channel routes mount at the RAW authored path (urlPath = route.path, no channel prefix; verified in eve compiler normalize-channel under 0.19 and proven through the proxy in spike/tests/mocked.test.ts at POST /eve/v1/platform/dispatch). HISTORICAL: compiler v1/v2 authored trigger channels under /eve/v1/platform/<trigger>; compiler v3 (agents-first) DELETED trigger-channel codegen -- compiled agents expose ONLY eve's default channel, and the control-plane dispatcher drives runs through eve's session API. The raw-path finding still matters for any future custom channel and for proxy forwarding of /eve/*; note that 0.31 changed the custom-channel route-handler argument shape (no bare `send` in RouteHandlerArgs), so any custom channel must be re-typechecked against 0.31.
